verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Radar as a feature built directly into Stripe's own payments processing (rules, reviews, risk settings, session tokenization, testing tied to Stripe test cards) with no mention of usable integration with other PSPs, gateways, or platforms. Fraud-detection tools in general could plausibly support multi-processor use, but nothing in the pack shows Radar operating outside Stripe's own rails — it is described purely as a Stripe-native capability.
